documents.title: Noting In The Board Meeting Dated 29.10.2026 Delay In Submission Of Shareholding Pattern Under Reg 31(1)(B) To NSE.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

analysis.summary: Menon Bearings reported consolidated total income of INR 194.9 crores for H1 FY27, representing a 47% growth over the previous year. Management projects revenue growth of more than 30% for both FY27 and FY28, supported by strong performance in domestic and US export markets. The company plans automation investments of around INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months. Despite raw material cost inflation in tin, copper, and steel, profitability has been sustained through a 25% increase in productivity and process optimization. The company is funding its capital expenditure entirely through internal accruals without taking term loans.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue growth to be more than 30% for FY27 and FY28.
guidance.quote: There will be more than 30% growth for this year, FY27, and similarly in '27-'28 also we expect, if all the things are in place, it will be more than 30% again, with the growth drivers are basically domestic and whatever export that USA exports are growing rapidly.

guidance.claim: The company expects additional business of around INR 30 crores on a consolidated basis for FY27.
guidance.quote: And what I feel, that considering the current business pipeline and the commercial discussions and RFQs that we have received, for '26-'27, additional business expected is around INR 30 crores on consolidated basis.

guidance.claim: Estimated additional business for FY28 is expected to be INR 131 crores.
guidance.quote: And for '27-'28, we expect that estimated additional business will be of INR 131 crores, so that, the growth rate will be obviously more than 30%

guidance.claim: Additional business of INR 157 crores is expected for 2029, excluding potential European business.
guidance.quote: And with this, for 2029, we expect additional business of INR 157 crores, excluding potential business of INR 35 crores of Europe that we estimate it will take little more time, but 100% we are going to convert that.

guidance.claim: Management targets EBITDA margins of about 23% for next year.
guidance.quote: And what we are targeting for next year, the EBITDA margins will be about 23%.

guidance.claim: Components developed or under development for clients hold a revenue potential of approximately ₹55 crore annually.
guidance.quote: These components hold a revenue potential of approximately ₹55 crore annually.

guidance.claim: Management expects total potential additional business of INR 65 crores to INR 75 crores over the current and next financial year.
guidance.quote: The total potential of additional business for the current and next financial year is expected to be around INR65 crores to INR75 crores, subject to good monsoon and geopolitical situation doesn't worsen further.

guidance.claim: Management stated that revenue guidance of INR 360 crores is a conservative target for the full year.
guidance.quote: So, INR360 crores, I would say is a conservative figure and we will stick to that.

guidance.claim: The company expects export revenue share to increase to around 37% by next year.
guidance.quote: As we expect that by next year, the export may go up to 37% after total revenue.

guidance.claim: Management sets a conservative target of 20% plus year-on-year growth.
guidance.quote: You see, there is always a target, we have set ourselves on a conservative basis of 20% plus year on year.

guidance.claim: Menon Alkop is targeting revenue of INR 100 crores for this year and around INR 125 crores for next year.
guidance.quote: For this year, we are targeting Alkop for INR100 crores, next year around INR125 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects to sustain consolidated EBITDA margins of around 20% to 21% over time.
guidance.quote: But overall, on a consolidated basis, if you see, we will sustainaround 20% to 21% of margins over a period of time.

demand_outlook.claim: OEM business grew by almost 50% and exports grew by over 75% compared to the same quarter last year.
demand_outlook.quote: We can see there is a growth as compared to the same quarter last year. There is a growth in OEM's business by almost 50%, and similarly there is a growth in export more than 75%.

demand_outlook.claim: Schedules from tractor companies are increasing despite drought-like conditions in Maharashtra.
demand_outlook.quote: But in spite of that drought-like situation, so far as Maharashtra is concerned, and maybe other states as well in throughout India, but at the same time it is surprising that our schedules from tractor companies are increasing --

demand_outlook.claim: End-market demand outlook for automotive and engineering sectors remains encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: While the global business environment continues to present certain uncertainties, the underlying demand outlook for the automotive and engineering sector remains encouraging.

demand_outlook.claim: Visits to Canada and the USA are expected to generate substantial business volumes in the coming period.
demand_outlook.quote: That is because, more particularly, due to our last month's visit to Canada and USA, is expected to yield substantial volumes in the coming period of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon impact on the tractor segment is expected to improve in the coming months.
demand_outlook.quote: You see, considering the monsoon position that may -- in tractor segment affect today to some extent, not larger, because in some parts there is a drought-like situation, but it is expected to improve within this month or next month.

capex_expansion.claim: Menon Bearings plans to invest around INR 5 crores in Menon Alkop and INR 4.5 crores in Menon Bearings over the next 12 to 15 months.
capex_expansion.quote: And I will not say only for automation and R&D how much we are investing, but next two years in Menon Bearings and Alkop, 12 months, around INR5 crores in Menon Alkop and around INR4.5 crores in Menon Bearings.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is investing INR 9 crores to INR 10 crores this financial year to expand capacity by 25% to 30%.
capex_expansion.quote: If you go through the presentation, Rucheeta, you will come to know that we are investing about INR9 crores to INR10 crores of rupees for this year, this financial year for increasing the capacity and which is expected to increase the capacity by almost 25% to 30%, which may yield the total revenue of more than INR25 crores, which can generate revenue of INR25 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Menon Alkop is undergoing CapEx of around INR 4 crores for the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: And we are having the CapEx of around INR4 crores of for this year in Alkop alone.

capex_expansion.claim: Brakes testing dynamometer is under construction and expected to be installed by the end of August.
capex_expansion.quote: You see, basically that is under construction now and is expected by the end of August.

margins_costs.claim: Prices for tin, copper, and steel increased by 72%, 50%, and 12% respectively.
margins_costs.quote: Just to put in numbers, tin has increased by 72%, copper by 50%, steel by 12%.

margins_costs.claim: Productivity increased by 25% over the previous period, helping reduce overall overheads.
margins_costs.quote: Apart from that, you can see there is a volume growth and productivity has substantially increased, that is by 25% over last period.

margins_costs.claim: Product margins are 30% to 35% in Brakes, 18% to 19% in Alkop, and 23% in Bearings.
margins_costs.quote: Okay, so far as Brakes is concerned, the margins are 30% to 35%. It depends upon the mix of the product, but it is between 30% to 35%, okay, that is one thing. In Alkop, it is 18% to 19%, whereas in Bearing, it is 23%, okay?

margins_costs.claim: Five robotic automation initiatives rolling out between November 2026 and April 2027 aim to increase productivity, quality, and machine utilization.
margins_costs.quote: Five initiatives rolling out Nov 2026 – Apr 2027 to lift productivity, quality and machine utilization

margins_costs.claim: The brake segment achieved 25% EBITDA margin in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: But at the same time, I would like to tell you that right from 12% EBITDA earlier, now we have reached to 25% EBITDA in brakes also.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for bi-metal and Alkop were both around 21% in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: So, for the bi-metal is concerned the margin, so, EBITDA margins are around 21% plus. Then Alkop, it is almost 21%.

margins_costs.claim: Prices of carbide tools consumables surged by 300%.
margins_costs.quote: Consumables, for example, carbide tools for all manufacturers, all automobile carbide tools are required.Those carbide tools price are increased by 300%.

orders_capacity.claim: European client interactions have yielded potential business of over INR 35 crores expected to convert into sales in FY28 and FY29.
orders_capacity.quote: Along with that, our recently Europe tour is yielding a significant increase in the business and potential of more than INR 35 crores that will be converted into the actual sale in the year '27-'28 and '28-'29.

orders_capacity.claim: Menon Alkop has developed around 54 parts over the last two years.
orders_capacity.quote: For Menon Alkop, we have developed around 54 parts in the last two years, and they all SOB has begun.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for Brake Lines stands at 30 lakh units per annum.
The company has an RFQ list of about INR 75 crores under discussion across Aluminium and Bi-metal divisions.
orders_capacity.quote: So, put together, Alkop, that is Aluminium and Bi-metal put together, the list of such RFQ list is about INR75 crores of rupees apart from the potential business that we may get through our visits to Canada and USA, that is different.

orders_capacity.claim: Peak revenue potential from current bi-metal capacity is above INR 400 crores.
orders_capacity.quote: Peak revenue from this, it can be aboveINR400 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has not taken any term loan for over six months, funding CapEx entirely through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, basically what we have done in the past for more than six months, we have not availed any term loan. Whatever CapEx that we are doing, that is out of internal accruals, which are definitely having the impact on the cash accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: CapEx for bi-metal and Alkop will be funded completely through internal accruals without taking fresh debt.
capital_allocation.quote: You see, so far as whatever we are considering so far as bi-metal and Alkop is concerned, it will be through internal accruals only, no fresh loan will be taken.

risks_headwinds.claim: Freight costs for export shipments to the USA and Europe have increased substantially.
risks_headwinds.quote: So far sales and distribution expenses are concerned in exports; the freight so far as shipment of exports to USA and maybe other European countries as well. That has substantially gone up, and because of that, the sales and distribution expenses have gone up substantially.

risks_headwinds.claim: Merchant export orders were delayed in the last three months due to war and backlogs in the Strait of Hormuz.
risks_headwinds.quote: But last three months, those merchant export orders were stuck because of backlog because of the Straight of Hormuz and the war.

risks_headwinds.claim: Steep price competition from China in Dubai and Africa affects export margins for brake linings.
risks_headwinds.quote: And since there is a steep competition from China, particularly in Dubai and African countries for brake linings, we have to keep the minimum margins so far as exports are concerned to these countries.
